stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 23.

_Instead of getting technology that allowed us to instantly go anywhere we want, we got technology that gave us no reason to leave home._

The author uses antithesis in the sentence to stress the idea that —

options.label: A
options.text: designs for flying cars have changed considerably from the past to the present

options.label: B
options.text: the promise that advanced technology provides greater freedom is false

options.label: C
options.text: fictional accounts of future technology rarely prove to be accurate

options.label: D
options.text: people today lack the imagination to find a practical use for flying cars
